source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 26 to 30
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 23, 2026 · 18 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! The Séance of Blake Manor Raw Fury ☆☆☆☆☆ 64 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass The Séance of Blake Manor – October 27Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere It is October 28th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman. What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world – waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead. Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together. Mouthwashing CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ 175 ★★★★★ $12.99 $10.39 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Mouthwashing – October 29XBOX Play Anywhere Mouthwashing is a first-person horror game following the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter. Who could have known what good ol’ Captain Curly was capable of? Guess he thought his crew dying alongside him was only right. But some men can’t even kill themselves properly. Maimed, limbless and unable to speak, but alive, Curly is now at the mercy of the crew he has doomed to a slow death. The Wolf Among Us Remastered Telltale ☆☆☆☆☆ 71 ★★★★★ $24.99 $19.99 Get it now The Wolf Among Us Remastered – October 29 Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered – the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before – honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players. Queen's Domain Future Friends Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 16 ★★★★★ $19.99 $16.99 Get it now Queen’s Domain – October 30 Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) Funktronic Labs ☆☆☆☆☆ 144 ★★★★★ $12.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) – October 26Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training. Terrible Lizards Digital Pajamas ☆☆☆☆☆ 196 ★★★★★ $24.99 $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Terrible Lizards – October 29Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Something is very wrong at Dalton’s Dinos, the once must-see Route 66 roadside attraction baking under the New Mexico sun. The staff have vanished, but a mysterious voice on the telephone you find in the attraction begs you for help to find a missing child. You’d leave… if your car hadn’t died miles from anywhere. It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction. Ayasa: Shadows of Silence Aya Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now Ayasa: Shadows of Silence – October 26 Step into the eerie world of Ayasa, a dark tale that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a haunting journey. Without a single spoken word, the story is told through pantomime, surreal imagery, and a soundtrack composed by Komitas. You will navigate six symbolic lands Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal—each corrupted by darkness. Every choice you make, every act of compassion or indifference, may lead to an unexpected ending. Will you restore balance or become the very force you sought to defeat? PAO PAO (Game Preview) Dreland Enterprises ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Free Trial PAO PAO – October 26 Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different. Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services Destroyer Doggo ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services – October 27XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services, where things don’t need to be perfect — just a little cleaner, a little calmer, and a little more you. Whether you’re curled up with a podcast or just need something peaceful to help the world feel quieter, this gentle 2D pressure washing game is here for you. No timers, no stress, just pastel pixel art, soft sounds, and the satisfying swish of clean water. Bloom Busters UBrothers ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bloom Busters – October 27Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Bloomland is under attack. A toxic infestation has twisted its gardens and filled them with cheeky mutated creatures – and Jimmy and Jessie are ready to clean up the mess. Bloom Busters is a frantic, old-school action arcade adventure with a distinctive isometric perspective. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op as you bash

source.title: Aloft and Conan Exiles Enhanced launch on PS5 in early 2027
source.evidenceText: October 27, 2026October 27, 2026 Aloft and Conan Exiles Enhanced launch on PS5 in early 2027 2 0 41 Like this Greetings from the clouds and Exiled Lands. Jarle Hrafn Grindhaug Communications Manager, Funcom We’ve just launched Dune: Awakening on PlayStation 5, but we’re only getting started. We’re excited to bring two more of our open-world survival adventures to PlayStation 5 in early 2027. Soar the skies in Aloft, then visit the unforgiving Exiled Lands in Conan Exiles Enhanced. Aloft: Build a home among the clouds Play Video After six years of heartfelt development with a team that grew from a small group of friends to the Astrolabe of today, we are ecstatic to reveal that our cozy co-op sandbox survival game in the clouds, Aloft, makes its console debut with Funcom as a publisher on PS5 early 2027. The PS5 version includes all the updates released during the game’s Early Access period on PC, as well as the 1.0 experience, bringing our complete vision of Aloft to life, filled with new content, stories, and so many improvements. Turn floating islands into skyships, build a home among the clouds, and explore a colorful open world alone or with friends. Since launching in Early Access, we have introduced five major content updates to Aloft, featuring new wildlife, puzzles, combat improvements, glider customization, expanded exploration, and much more. Discover lost knowledge, cure fungal corruption, care for your animals, brave hurricanes as you restore the ecosystem and uncover new adventures across the skies. Launching the complete game on PS5 marks an exciting new chapter for us. Aloft has always been a passion project fueled by the unwavering support and love of our community. Reaching this milestone is incredibly exciting, as this will mark a new era for the game – we really hope you will be part of our flight. Conan Exiles Enhanced: Survive the brutal, yet beautiful Exiled Lands We are thrilled to announce that Conan Exiles Enhanced is coming to PS5. All players who own Conan Exiles on PlayStation will get the Enhanced version for PlayStation 5 for free. Both PS4 and PS5 versions will be available to purchase. Buy one version and get the other for free. All your purchased Bazaar items and DLC will also carry over from PS4 to PS5 seamlessly. The Enhanced edition brings improved environments, characters, lighting, and effects, along with a redesigned UI and performance and quality-of-life improvements. Play Video The update also makes exploring the Exiled Lands and the Isle of Siptah expansion a more seamless experience. Isle of Siptah remains a separate purchase. The new Legacy of the Giant-Kings story arc will be included in the console launch of Conan Exiles Enhanced, bringing an exciting new narrative experience to console players from day one. Players will be able to uncover the mysteries of the ancient Giant-Kings, explore their forgotten legacy, and embark on a journey filled with new challenges, discoveries, and rewards. Its inclusion ensures console players can experience this major story arc as part of the enhanced Conan Exiles experience at launch. We’ll share release dates and more details for both games at a later date. Wishlist both games now at PlayStation Store. AloftConan ExilesFuncom Did you like this?
